thread:
alex: Heads-up — the new attention kernels landed in main and CI is showing a ~46% jump in linux runtime binary size. probably from LTO + fatbin including multiple cubins/PTX versions.
mira: ugh. observed that locally too. did we accidentally compile for sm_70/75/80/86 by default?
sam: i think nvcc gencode matrix expanded when we added support for sm86 optimizations. flags in build: 
```
NVCCFLAGS += -O3 -Xcompiler -fPIC --use_fast_math -lineinfo
NVCC_GENCODE += -gencode arch=compute_70,code=sm_70 -gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 -gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86
LTO=1
```
jen: LTO helps perf, but it can bloat the link step if we don't strip or split artifacts. also fatbin bundles PTX for each arch which scales size.
raj: can we change CI to produce per-arch artifacts (e.g., runtime-sm80.cubin, runtime-sm86.cubin, runtime-ptx7.ptx) and then implement a runtime router that picks the right file? avoids shipping all to hosted.
lia: that sounds good for hosted, but Dedicated/Private still need options. maybe have a "dev" fat artifact for quick deploys and a "prod" per-arch bundle.
ci-bot: build-1234 completed: total runtime.so = 48.2MB (previous baseline 33.1MB). flagged by size-gate.
alex: proposal: 1) narrow default gencode whitelist in CI to supported customer regions (sm80, sm86) 2) add a separate job that builds an expanded fatbin (for testing) 3) enable strip/debug symbol removal and compress artifacts 4) add artifact size gate with per-arch thresholds
mira: agree. also we should downgrade PTX target for fallback (generate ptx 7.0 instead of 8.0) so older drivers can JIT from a single PTX instead of shipping multiple cubins. small ptx file <-> big bin files tradeoff.
sam: concrete nvcc flags I'd try: 
```
NVCCFLAGS += -Xptxas -v --ptxas-options=-O2
NVCC_GENCODE = -gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 -gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86
# optional fallback ptx
NVCCFLAGS += -gencode arch=compute_80,code=compute_80
# strip symbols at link: ar -s / strip --strip-unneeded
```
jen: also consider compiling with `-Xlinker --exclude-libs,ALL` for static libs, and run `llvm-strip`/`strip` on the final shared object. LTO should be optional per-build matrix.
raj: CI changes: add jobs: build-per-arch, build-fatbin-debug, build-fatbin-release. artifact naming: runtime-<platform>-sm<arch>.{so,ptx,cubin}. Also add checksum metadata.
lia: small nit — for on-prem we might need a single-file runtime for air-gapped installs. maybe provide a packaged fat runtime for private customers behind a flag.
alex: yep. default in repo: per-arch outputs and a `make bundle-fatbin` target that packs them into runtime-fatbin.tar.gz for private/enterprise. hosted API will deploy per-arch.
ci-bot: new CI patch proposal created: pipeline changes + size-gate job. see https://ci.redwood.local/pipeline/PR-8123 : size thresholds default: 40MB for linux runtime.so, per-arch +/- 5MB.
infra-bot: FYI we have kernel toolchains pinned in images: cuda-12.1, driver 535.x. if we change ptx target we'll need to update image matrix.
mira: another experiment: build with `-Xcompiler -flto=thin` instead of full LTO; thinner link-time opt but preserves some speedups and smaller size. can someone run perf vs size?
sam: i'll run a quick perf/size matrix and post numbers.
jen: for CI gating, add a job that computes "delta from baseline" and only fails if >15% (or absolute > 10MB). prevents flakey fails for small tweaks.
raj: added an action to upload per-arch artifact sizes to the artifacts dashboard so we can trend.
lia: question: should we keep PTX in the artifact at all for hosted? we could pre-compile cubins for each region/hardware and drop PTX to reduce size / allow faster loads. downside: less JIT flexibility. tradeoffs.
alex: agree. default: keep PTX for sm80 only as fallback, and precompile cubins for supported SM targets. document in eng-runtime/BUILD.md.
sam: results: building with thin-lto + per-arch outputs -> runtime total 35.4MB, perf within 1.8% of full-fat LTO. I'll upload numbers in the PR.
mira: great. PR should include updated nvcc flags, CI jobs, and a tiny script `scripts/bundle_artifacts.sh` that creates optional fat tarball.
jen: also add an audit job that runs `readelf -s` and `nm` to ensure debug symbols stripped.
ci-bot: PR-8123 size-gate run: PASS (35.4MB <= 40MB).
alex: next steps: (1) land PR with flags and CI split (2) update runtime router to look for per-arch files in deploy (3) docs + private bundle script. thanks team. :tada: 
lia: thanks! will coordinate docs for private deploys. :+1:
